Public Works Department, Govt of Gujarat 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Gujarat · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/35/2013/062 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Check Dam - Gujarat Pkg-62" (irrigation), awarded to M/s National
 Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all
 respects on 20/03/2013 at a gross executed value of INR 46.73 Cr (Rupees 46.73 Crore Only).
 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
 conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
 
 undersigned. 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Naveen Roy. This certificate is issued for record and for
 
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Public Works Department, Govt of Gujarat 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-062 Page 1 of 1
